summary: Add guru-owned persistent cache dir + ReadWritePaths (bootstrap + systemd unit)
description: Repo changes so a fresh box provisions the stable cache path. deploy/vps-bootstrap.sh: create /srv/guru-web/next-cache owned guru:guru mode 0750 (idempotent, guarded like the other steps). deploy/guru-web.service: add 'ReadWritePaths=/srv/guru-web/next-cache' alongside the existing ReadWritePaths=/srv/guru-web/current, so ProtectSystem=strict permits writes there. No behavior change until deploy.sh points the symlink at it (next child). Done: both files updated + committed.
